controls.name: Quality Management System Scope
controls.description: Define the boundaries, services, locations and applicability of the QMS.

controls.name: Quality Policy
controls.description: Set leadership commitments for quality, customer focus and continual improvement.

controls.name: QMS Process Map and Process Register
controls.description: Identify QMS processes, interactions, owners, inputs, outputs and performance criteria.

controls.name: Quality Objectives and KPI Plan
controls.description: Set measurable quality objectives, owners, resources, dates and evaluation methods.

controls.name: Quality Risks and Opportunities Register
controls.description: Identify and treat risks and opportunities that affect QMS results and customer satisfaction.

controls.name: QMS Change Planning and Approval Procedure
controls.description: Plan changes so responsibilities, resources and QMS integrity are maintained.

controls.name: Quality Resources and Infrastructure Plan
controls.description: Provide and maintain people, infrastructure, environment and resources needed for quality.

controls.name: Organisational Knowledge Register
controls.description: Identify, maintain and share knowledge required to operate processes effectively.

controls.name: Quality Competence and Training Matrix
controls.description: Define competence needs, close gaps and retain evidence of competence.

controls.name: QMS Communication Plan
controls.description: Define important internal and external quality communications and responsibilities.

controls.name: Customer Communication and Requirements Review Procedure
controls.description: Review, agree, control and communicate customer and applicable requirements.

controls.name: Design and Development Procedure
controls.description: Control design and development where applicable, including review, verification, validation and change.

controls.name: External Provider Approval and Performance Procedure
controls.description: Approve, control and monitor suppliers and external providers proportionate to risk.

controls.name: Service Delivery and Operational Control Procedure
controls.description: Deliver products and services under controlled conditions with suitable resources and information.

controls.name: Customer and External Provider Property Register
controls.description: Identify and protect property belonging to customers and external providers.

controls.name: Product and Service Release Checklist
controls.description: Confirm acceptance requirements before release and retain authorisation evidence.

controls.name: Nonconforming Output Procedure and Register
controls.description: Identify, control and resolve outputs that do not meet requirements.

controls.name: Quality Monitoring, Measurement and Analysis Plan
controls.description: Define what quality performance is measured, how, when and how results are evaluated.

controls.name: Customer Satisfaction and Feedback Procedure
controls.description: Monitor customer perceptions and convert feedback into action and improvement.

controls.name: Customer Complaint Handling Procedure and Register
controls.description: Acknowledge, investigate, resolve and learn from customer complaints.

controls.name: Monitoring and Measuring Resources Register
controls.description: Maintain suitable monitoring and measuring resources and traceability where required.

controls.name: QMS Internal Audit Checklist and Report
controls.description: Audit QMS conformity, implementation and process effectiveness using objective evidence.

controls.name: QMS Management Review Agenda and Minutes
controls.description: Provide management with the required QMS performance, change and improvement review.

controls.name: Root Cause and Corrective Action Form
controls.description: Record correction, cause analysis, corrective action, effectiveness and closure.

controls.name: Continual Improvement Register
controls.description: Capture, prioritise, implement and evaluate continual improvement opportunities.
